- * fblock terminates with a {@link jdk.incubator.code.dialect.core.CoreOp.ReturnOp return operation}, - * whose operand is the operation result of the quoted op. + * Returns quoting code model whose behavior quotes the given source operation. @@ -161,4 +143,5 @@ - * @param op the operation - * @return the quoting code model. - * @throws IllegalArgumentException if {@code op} is not placed in a block. - * @throws IllegalStateException if an encountered block is being built and is not observable. + * @param op the source operation to quote + * @return the quoting code model + * @throws IllegalArgumentException if {@code op} is not placed in a block + * @see #embedOp(Op, Map) + * @see Quoted @@ -171,1 +154,25 @@ - * Embeds the given operation into a quoting code model whose behavior quotes the operation. + * Returns quoting code model whose behavior quotes the given source operation. + *

+ * A quoting code model is a {@link jdk.incubator.code.dialect.core.CoreOp.FuncOp function operation} that has one + * body with one block, fblock, and whose behavior returns an instance of {@link Quoted} that contains a copy + * of the source operation. + *

+ * The source operation has a sequence of values, source values, that is the operation's + * {@link Op#operands() operands} followed by the operation's {@link Op#capturedValues() captured values}. + * The quoting function operation has a sequence of values, quoting values, mapped from the source values. + * Each quoting value is a block parameter of fblock, the result of variable operation in fblock + * initialized with a block parameter of fblock, or the result of constant operation in fblock. + *

+ * For each source value, if the value has an entry in the captured constants, then fblock will contain a + * constant operation whose constant value is the entry's value. The source value is mapped to a quoting value that + * is the result of the constant operation. Otherwise, if the value has no entry in the captured constants, + * fblock has a block parameter in the same order as the source value. If the source value is the result of a + * {@link jdk.incubator.code.dialect.core.CoreOp.VarOp variable operation} then the block parameter's code type is + * the same as variable operation's value type, and fblock has a variable operation whose operand is the + * block parameter. The source value is mapped to a quoting value that is the result of the variable operation. + * Otherwise, the block parameter's code type is the same as the source value's code type. The source value is + * mapped to a quoting value that is the block parameter. + *

- * Then fblock has a {@link jdk.incubator.code.dialect.core.CoreOp.QuotedOp quoted operation} - * that has one body with one block (qblock).
